This is a real direct RNA sequencing example copied from the ninetails package:
/inst/extdata/test_data/pod5_DRS/filtered.pod5

The original file was copied without further changes to its content and renamed
here to drs-filtered.pod5. It is provided for testing package functionality 
on real-life example rather than using some artificial fixtures.

No simulated dataset was generated for this purpose.

The original sequencing run was performed in Laboratory of RNA Biology
at the International Institute of Molecular and Cell Biology in Warsaw.
